query:
SELECT ph.id, ph.card_id, ph.grade, ph.price, ph.currency, ph.jpy_price, ph.sold_at, ph.source
FROM price_history ph
WHERE ph.grade IN ('PSA10', 'PSA 10')
  AND CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL) < 2000
ORDER BY ph.sold_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
